name: Murray's Lessee v. Hoboken Land & Improvement Co.
summary: The Supreme Court held that Congress could authorize summary collection of debts owed to the government through executive action rather than Article III court proceedings, establishing the historical foundation for the public rights doctrine.
significance: One of the foundational cases defining the scope of 'public rights' that Congress may assign to non-Article III adjudication, relevant to determining whether H-2A enforcement falls within that category.
